fusions.name: Struck-Iron Ping
fusions.desc: Sends the ring of struck iron into the first enemy in its path for 4 resonating damage, with a 40% chance to leave it [Leaden] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Belfry Toll
fusions.desc: Tolls a note that deals 14 resonating damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stuns them for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Bell's Answer
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 30% of the damage you take echoes back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Carrying Echo
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, the echo strikes the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 6 lightning damage. Once every 4 seconds.
